_help: Settings for the real-data build (python data/build_real.py). Paths are relative to data/. Set a path to null to skip that source; its fake file then stays in data/out/.
name: Mount Sharp boxwork region, Gale crater (placeholder: confirm with Zakiyyah)
_center_note: PLACEHOLDER. Replace with the real site centre once the site is chosen. Longitude is degrees east, 0 to 360.

themis._kind_help: thermal_inertia = quantitative TI in SI units (best); night_ir = night-time brightness only (qualitative, still shows sand vs rock)
themis.label: THEMIS (Mars Odyssey), thermal inertia mosaic

crism._threshold_note: Thresholds are starting values to tune by eye, not published cut-offs. Use band (a number from 1) if band_name does not match.
crism.label: CRISM (MRO), MTRDR summary parameters

rems._dust_note: REMS does not measure dust opacity (tau). This single value is an estimate for the season; replace it with a Mastcam tau value if you find one.
rems.label: REMS (Curiosity)

rad._qf_note: Converts absorbed dose (Gy) to dose equivalent (Sv). 3.05 = 0.64 mSv/day / 0.21 mGy/day, the surface averages Hassler et al. (2014, Science) reported from RAD. An approximation.
rad.label: RAD (Curiosity)
